items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached underwater aquarium background. Keep portrait 9:16, the bright blue open ocean, underwater viewpoint, surface rays, sandy seabed, and clean central swimming space. The user finds the two tiny fan corals too sparse for a premium mood theme. Make the natural reef notably fuller and more detailed: enlarge red sea-fan coral groups along both side edges, layered overlapping fans in crimson, muted terracotta, burgundy and soft peach, branching vein detail, a few smaller supporting fans and rounded encrusting corals on textured rock bases. Reef clusters should rise along the outer left/right thirds, richest at bottom corners, leaving the central 50-55% width unobstructed with low-contrast blue water for fish. Add depth through staggered foreground and softer midground coral silhouettes. Fuller than source, elegant and believable, not a maximalist wall of detail. Preserve soft polished storybook painting and lighting. No fish, people, animals, text, buildings, ornaments, UI or frame. Opaque image.
